Name: Camera Control (smooth Zoom - smooth Panning - Free ToolBar - no boundaries - no blurry pixels)
Author: Nitbundier
Description:
Camera Follows Mouse: viewPort can be set to follow Mouse making it panning
Fix Blurry Pixels when zoomed: when the zoom level is other than 1.0 the game show pixels of the game blurry sometimes, this mod tries to fix some of them at other zoom levels.
Zoom With Keyboard. Zoom With Mouse. auto Map specific Zoom. reset, maximize or minimize zoom with key.
you can also toggle ui visibility.
+ ability to not pass empty toolBars : i like my hand not Holding into somthing 24h , ok ?
All Configurable with Generic Mod Config Menu Mod.
